# hiok_vm_snapshot (Resource)

A restore point of a virtual machine. Destroying it deletes the snapshot.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Snapshot name.
- `vm_name` (String) The VM's name.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `include_memory` (Boolean) Capture RAM too, so a restore resumes execution.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `state` (String) What the VM was doing when it was taken.
